grammar.topic: Week review: conditionals (0, 1st, 2nd, unless) and the passive
explainTr: Bu hafta dört koşul yapısı ve iki edilgen yapı gördün. Zero conditional genel gerçekler için (If + present, present), 1st conditional gerçekçi gelecek için (If + present, will), 2nd conditional hayali durumlar için (If + past, would).
'Unless' = if ... not; yanında olumlu fiil kullanırsın. Edilgen: şimdiki zamanda is/are + V3 (is sent), geçmişte was/were + V3 (was built).
Okul duyurularında bu yapılar yan yana gelir: 'Forms are sent home. If it snows, the event will be postponed.' Bugün gerçek bir duyuru okuyacaksın; haftanın tüm yapılarını bulmaya çalış.
grammar.compareTr: Türkçede -sa/-se eki bütün koşulları kapsar; zamanı bağlam belirler. İngilizcede zaman seçimi önemlidir: gerçek ihtimal için If + present + will, hayal için If + past + would. Edilgende de Türkçedeki -ıl/-ilmek eki yerine be + V3 gelir.

reading.title: A school newsletter
reading.text:
LINCOLN ELEMENTARY NEWS - Friday, November 7

Dear Lincoln families,

Family Night will be held on Thursday, November 20, from 5:30 to 7:30 p.m. in the cafeteria and the gym. The event was first organized in 1985, and it is still our favorite tradition. Every family is invited, and the evening is free, but donations for the new library are welcome.

Please register by Friday, November 14. Registration forms are available in the front office and on the school website. If you register after the deadline, we cannot promise a seat at dinner. A small fee of $5 per family is required for the pizza dinner, unless your child receives free lunch.

Volunteers are needed! If you can help with setup, decorations or cleanup, please contact Mr. Brown. Volunteers are asked to arrive at 4:30 p.m. We also need two parents to supervise the games in the gym.

Please note: if it snows heavily, the event will be postponed to Thursday, December 4. The decision will be announced on the school website by 3:00 p.m., and a reminder will be sent by text message.

Early dismissal: On Friday, November 21, school will be dismissed at 1:00 p.m. because of teacher meetings. Buses will leave at 1:15. If you need to pick up your child earlier, please sign out in the front office.

We hope to see you all there!
Mr. Brown, Front Office

script.speaker: Hafsa
script.text: Good morning, Mr. Brown. This is Hafsa. I read the newsletter about Family Night.

script.speaker: Mr. Brown
script.text: Good morning, Hafsa! Are you planning to attend?

script.speaker: Hafsa
script.text: Yes, and I would like to volunteer. What do you need?

script.speaker: Mr. Brown
script.text: If you can come at 4:30, you can help with the decorations.

script.speaker: Hafsa
script.text: That's no problem. Do I need to register?

script.speaker: Mr. Brown
script.text: Please register Emre and yourself by Friday. I will add your name to the volunteer list.

script.speaker: Mr. Brown
script.text: It is five dollars per family for dinner. But if you volunteer, dinner is free.

script.speaker: Hafsa
script.text: That is kind. What if it snows?

script.speaker: Mr. Brown
script.text: Then the event will be postponed. You will see an announcement on the website, and a reminder will be sent by text.

script.speaker: Hafsa
script.text: Perfect. Could you send me the volunteer form by email?

script.speaker: Mr. Brown
script.text: Sure. Please reply to my email when you get it.

script.speaker: Hafsa
script.text: Thank you, Mr. Brown. See you on Thursday.

questions.q: Why does Hafsa call Mr. Brown?
options: She wants to change the date.

questions.whyTr: Mr. Brown: 'If you can come at 4:30'.
Mr. Brown: 'if you volunteer, dinner is free.'

questions.q: What should Hafsa do when she gets the email?
questions.whyTr: Mr. Brown: 'Please reply to my email when you get it.'

writing.promptTr: Mr. Brown'a e-posta ile cevap yaz: Aile Gecesi'nde gönüllü olmak istediğini söyle ve iki soru sor.
writing.promptEn: Write a reply email to Mr. Brown. Say that you want to volunteer for Family Night and ask two questions.
writing.model: Dear Mr. Brown, Thank you for the newsletter about Family Night. I would like to volunteer. I can help with the decorations, and I can arrive at 4:30. If you need more help, I can also supervise the games in the gym. I have two questions. Is the volunteer form available online? And what will happen if it snows? If the event is postponed, please send me a text message. I am looking forward to meeting the other parents and teachers. Thank you for your time. Best regards, Hafsa
checklistTr: Selamlama (Dear Mr. Brown) ve kapanış (Best regards) var mı?
Gönüllü olmak istediğini ve iki soruyu yazdın mı?
En az bir if cümlesi ve doğru zaman kullandın mı?
